title: FAQ — Tokyo Marathon 2027
claims: Baggage check must be selected at entry and cannot be added later.
Baggage check is only available to runners who applied at entry.
Packet pickup is at Tokyo Big Sight South Exhibition Hall and there is no race-day pickup.

claimVerification.note: FAQ 写明 baggage check 在报名时选择，报名完成后不能更改。
FAQ 写明 baggage check service 只对报名时申请者开放。
FAQ 写明领物地点与比赛日不领物。
